evals.prompt: Our Svelte pricing card now has an annual-discount badge. Add a Playwright visual TDD test for the card’s regular and discounted states at 390px and 1440px. The repository already has component-test stories and a pinned Chromium setup. Do not make CI update snapshots automatically.
evals.expected_output: A focused plan and/or implementation that reuses the component-test setup, creates deterministic state fixtures and semantic screenshot names, covers both requested viewports and states, starts comparison strictly, and describes explicit reviewed baseline approval rather than automatic CI updates.

evals.prompt: This Playwright screenshot test flakes every few CI runs: the only changed pixels are the current time in the dashboard header and a chart that is sometimes still loading. Make it reliable, but keep the visual test meaningful.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis and targeted test changes that fixture/freeze the timestamp, wait on a chart-specific readiness signal, avoid arbitrary sleeps and broad global tolerances, and only use a documented narrow mask if the time is genuinely irrelevant to the visual contract.

evals.prompt: The account settings screenshot comparison failed after my CSS change. I ran update snapshots and now it passes. What should I do before opening the PR?
evals.expected_output: A safe baseline-review workflow: rerun normal comparison, inspect expected/actual/diff/report, classify the change, inspect committed PNG scope and Git diff, keep artifacts out of Git, report viewport/project coverage, and do not treat a passing update run as approval.
